question: Can independent within-tile output workers remove the measured interleave, neutral-gauge and quantization bottleneck while preserving the exact cached Thomas RGB16 stream and ordered sink contract?

mechanism.field_and_development: exact P8CO full-field cache with three independent colour-layer workers
mechanism.output_partition: each ordered row tile is split into three contiguous pixel ranges
mechanism.output_workers: three independent workers perform field interleave, neutral gauge and sRGB16 quantization on disjoint ranges
mechanism.sink_order: wait for all three output ranges, then invoke the original sink once for the complete row tile

fixture.profile: exact P8CO synthetic amplitude, fields, neutral gauge and exposure formula

development_observation.interpretation: The output stage is about half of Android cached-parallel runtime; file-vs-discard ordering showed no consistent I/O cost.

claim_ceiling: Private exact 12MP raw RGB16 core performance on Windows x64 and Android 14 x86_64 virtual device; not PNG/file publication, physical arm64, JNI/app/media integration, calibrated film response or complete product export performance.
